verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same: a stacked headline, the window centred and the event details right-aligned underneath. In both, the details block sits tight against the bottom of the window, and its right edge (about x=382) doesn't line up with the window (about 325) or the headline's left axis, so the alignment looks ragged. A leaves a big empty band at the bottom with a small top margin, so it feels top-heavy. B moves the whole stack down, which makes the top and bottom margins more even.
